versions.sap_status_original: e.g. in transaction PFCG

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Check role SAP_BC_BMT_WFM_SERV_USER_PLV01 e.g. in transaction PFCG.

versions.sap_status_original: You define changeability of SAP system by transaction SE06

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: You define changeability of SAP system by transaction SE06. You reach this setting by the button "System Change Option" in the toolbar of transaction SE06.

versions.sap_status_original: transaction SE11 ... to find locations which SE11 cannot handle

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Determine object list of references to table pools and table clusters ... transaction SE11 and considering other techniques like transaction CODE_SCANNER to find locations which SE11 cannot handle.

versions.sap_status_original: Display the table content of table TADIR with transaction SE16

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Display the table content of table TADIR with transaction SE16 and select all SQLT object names with the selection "program id" = R3TR; "object type" = SQLT.

versions.sap_status_original: Go to transaction SE16N

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Go to transaction SE16N and type "T881" into the table field. Enter "FI" into the selection field Application and "SL" into the selection field Subapplication.

versions.sap_status_original: via the standard transactions SFP and SE24

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Develop and adapt your SAP Interactive Forms by Adobe via the standard transactions SFP and SE24.

versions.sap_status_original: Use transaction SE38 to create the program

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Use transaction SE38 to create the program ZCOPY_ENTRIES_FOR_GL_PLANNING (in a valid customer package) with the title "Copying of Entries for GL Planning", type 1 ("Executable Program").

versions.sap_status_original: create customer-owned job definitions via transaction SE80

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: It is possible for customers to create customer-owned job definitions via transaction SE80.

versions.sap_status_original: you can easily recreate them with transaction maintenance SE93

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: If you are missing plan/actual reporting transactions like S_E38_98000088 or S_PL0_86000031, you can easily recreate them with transaction maintenance SE93.

versions.sap_status_original: Check if the services are used via transaction SICF

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Check if the services are used via transaction SICF. Hierarchy Type = "Service", Service Name e.g. "QC40" and execute.

versions.sap_status_original: Call up transaction SM30

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Call up transaction SM30, enter view V_BPCONSTANTS and click Display.

versions.sap_status_original: Choosing Standard Jobs in transaction SM36

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Choosing Standard Jobs in transaction SM36 displayed a table of standard job templates which the customer could choose to schedule.

versions.sap_status_original: Deleting or modifying such jobs manually (via transaction SM37)

evidence.source_title: Simplification List for SAP S/4HANA 2025 – Feature Pack Stack 1
evidence.source_excerpt: Deleting or modifying such jobs manually (via transaction SM37) will not have a lasting effect since the automation mechanism will reschedule them.
